details.usageInstructions:
1. Hold the dhoop at the uncovered end of the stick and light the other end using a matchstick.
2. Hold the flame for some time until the dhoop ignites.
3. If you see a glowing amber, then the incense dhoop is burning properly. If you do not see anything, and the tip looks ashy, then you will need to relight the dhoop.
4. If the dhoop is still burning even after seeing the amber then gently blow out the flame.
5. Keep the burning dhoop away from flammable materials.
